title: Pim Tried to Warn Them 4 Times 🤐 #shorts
description: Pim lost his voice... and Mr. Pot is right there. Count his warnings! Full episode: "Pim Lost His Voice at the WORST Time?! 🤐 | EP 14" {LONG_URL} — more on https://www.youtube.com/@DoughBrosTV #shorts #animation #cartoon #doughbros #funnycartoon

beats.en: Pim has no voice. He must warn his friends.

beats.en: Warning one? You want to... dance? Later, Pim.
beats.de: Warnung eins? Du willst... tanzen? Später, Pim.
beats.fr: Alerte un ? Tu veux... danser ? Plus tard, Pim.

beats.en: Warning three: stomp stomp... SNACK TIME?
Warning four. He means: the pot is right BEHIND you.

beats.pt: Aviso quatro. Ele quer dizer: a panela tá bem ATRÁS de você.

beats.en: Four warnings. Zero listeners. Hee hee... Fresh... DOUGH!
